metadata.title: macroFileList Not Cleared on Logout — Cross-Session Disclosure and VULN-007 Chain Enabler

sources: ApplinX REST API getMacro() fileList response → this.macroList string array
sessionStorage.getItem('macroFileList') — persistent across same-tab session changes
transformations: app.component.ts line 652: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.macroList)) — redundant but harmless for string arrays
macro.component.ts line 118: tempMacroList.split(',') — comma-split with no escaping
sinks: this.selectedMacro → MacroService.deleteMacro() (chain to VULN-007 path traversal)

privilege_boundary.start_privilege: Authenticated ApplinX user (attacker is next user at shared workstation, or XSS executor)
privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Read access to prior user's macro names; injection of arbitrary macro names enabling VULN-007 path traversal

impact.description: Confidentiality: macro names (user activity metadata) disclosed to subsequent session users. Integrity: sessionStorage injection enables VULN-007 path traversal — arbitrary file operations on ApplinX server. The '[object Object]' Scanner claim was partially wrong — string arrays serialize correctly but comma format is fragile.

prerequisites: Shared browser (library/corporate workstation) OR prior XSS (VULN-004) to inject sessionStorage
Next user opens Macro panel after login

remediation.fix_approach: Add sessionStorage.removeItem('macroFileList') to StorageService.setNotConnected(). Fix storage: JSON.stringify(this.macroList). Fix read: JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('macroFileList') || '[]'). Apply MACRO_NAME_PATTERN filter on load.

history.note: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(array)) double serialization stores '[object Object]' in sessionStorage; macroFileList not cleared on logout

Confirmed. Critical finding: macroFileList not cleared in setNotConnected() enables cross-session disclosure and is prerequisite for VULN-007 path traversal chain. Scanner's '[object Object]' claim partially wrong — string arrays toString correctly. Part of AC-003.
